limitations: Fixed exposed development regression set, not blind evaluation
Supported and uncertain decisions come from the same model, not independent expert gold
Other predicates preserve raw meaning but do not validate precise typed retrieval; they can reflect ontology or datatype expression gaps
Context-local identities have not been merged across contexts or cases
Bounded context repair can change candidates within the failing context; semantic recall is not proven
Raw sources remain independently searchable; processed unit counts are accounting, not semantic recall
